beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Three thousand years ago a shepherd-king wrote a song about being shepherded himself. It starts like this:

timing.text: Three thousand years ago a shepherd-king wrote a song about being shepherded himself.
It starts like this:

beats.speaker: scripture
beats.text: The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want.

timing.text: The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: David begins with trust, not scarcity. Everything after that opening line shows what the Shepherd's care looks like.

timing.text: David begins with trust, not scarcity.
Everything after that opening line shows what the Shepherd's care looks like.

beats.speaker: scripture
beats.text: He maketh me to lie down in green pastures: he leadeth me beside the still waters.

timing.text: He maketh me to lie down in green pastures: he leadeth me beside the still waters.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The image is deliberate: a sheep lies down only when it feels safe.

timing.text: The image is deliberate: a sheep lies down only when it feels safe.
He restoreth my soul:

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The Shepherd does more than keep David alive; he brings him back when he is spent.

timing.text: The Shepherd does more than keep David alive; he brings him back when he is spent.

beats.speaker: scripture
beats.text: he leadeth me in the paths of righteousness for his name's sake.

timing.text: he leadeth me in the paths of righteousness for his name's sake.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The guarantee is the Shepherd's own character, not David's performance.

timing.text: The guarantee is the Shepherd's own character, not David's performance.

beats.speaker: scripture
beats.text: Yea, though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil: for thou art with me; thy rod and thy staff they comfort me.

timing.text: Yea, though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil: for thou art with me; thy rod and thy staff they comfort me.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Notice what changes here: up to now David has been saying He. In the valley he starts saying You. He gets closer to the Shepherd in the dark, not further away.

timing.text: Notice what changes here: up to now David has been saying He.
In the valley he starts saying You.

beats.speaker: scripture
beats.text: Thou preparest a table before me in the presence of mine enemies:

timing.text: Thou preparest a table before me in the presence of mine enemies:

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Even danger has to watch while the Shepherd provides.

timing.text: Even danger has to watch while the Shepherd provides.

beats.speaker: scripture
beats.text: thou anointest my head with oil; my cup runneth over.

timing.text: thou anointest my head with oil; my cup runneth over.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: This is welcome and abundance, not bare survival.

timing.text: This is welcome and abundance, not bare survival.

beats.speaker: scripture
beats.text: Surely goodness and mercy shall follow me all the days of my life:

timing.text: Surely goodness and mercy shall follow me all the days of my life:

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: David pictures those gifts not trailing weakly behind, but pursuing him.

timing.text: David pictures those gifts not trailing weakly behind, but pursuing him.

beats.speaker: scripture
beats.text: and I will dwell in the house of the LORD for ever.

timing.text: and I will dwell in the house of the LORD forever.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The song ends where every sheep longs to be: safely in the Shepherd's presence.

timing.text: The song ends where every sheep longs to be: safely in the Shepherd's presence.

card.text: The Shepherd who leads, restores, and walks the dark valley with you is the same One who invites you home. Let Him lead.
